primaryTextChecks.text: and he said to him, “Jephthah says: Israel didn’t take away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon;

context.text: Jephthah sent messengers again to the king of the children of Ammon;
but when they came up from Egypt, and Israel went through the wilderness to the Red Sea, and came to Kadesh,

primaryTextChecks.semanticDecisionJa: 「land of the children of Ammon」は土地を指す領域用法。前後は使者を通じたエフタの歴史的主張であり、境界の実証ではない。

primaryTextChecks.text: Therefore I have not sinned against you, but you do me wrong to war against me. May the LORD the Judge be judge today between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.”

context.text: Israel lived in Heshbon and its towns, and in Aroer and its towns, and in all the cities that are along the side of the Arnon for three hundred years! Why didn’t you recover them within that time?
However, the king of the children of Ammon didn’t listen to the words of Jephthah which he sent him.

primaryTextChecks.semanticDecisionJa: children of Ammonは交戦集団。場所プロフィールから除外。

primaryTextChecks.text: He struck them from Aroer until you come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and to Abelcheramim, with a very great slaughter. So the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.

context.text: So Jephthah passed over to the children of Ammon to fight against them; and the LORD delivered them into his hand.
Jephthah came to Mizpah to his house; and behold, his daughter came out to meet him with tambourines and with dances. She was his only child. Besides her he had neither son nor daughter.

primaryTextChecks.semanticDecisionJa: children of Ammonは敗北集団。場所プロフィールから除外。

wikipediaRead.title: Ammon
wikipediaRead.supportJa: L155はAmmonをヨルダン川東、アルノン/ヤボク間の古代王国とし、主要都市をラバと記す。L156は住民をChildren of Ammon/Ammonitesと呼び、地域名と集団を区別。L193は士師時代に関する叙述を置く。Wikipedia本文の歴史叙述をJDGのエフタの発話の独立した真偽判定には用いない。
wikipediaRead.qualityCaveatJa: 記事には出典・中立性に関する編集上の警告表示があるため、範囲説明は限定的な参考にとどめる。

decision: JDG11:15の既存place候補を地域用例として復帰。11:27/33の民族集団用例を場所へ関連付けない。
